{
  "stdout": "=== 36
Fixes #35.

Looks at the stop reason of the last response after a prompt settles. A `length` stop with no tool call gets a continuation with tools allowed: up to 3 cut-offs in a row, and the count resets when a continuation uses tools. Continuations stop at the `timeout`. Past the limit, pi posts an error with the partial text and suggests raising `model_max_tokens`. Partial text from a cut-off response is posted, marked as cut off. Continuation keys are stable, so re-runs don't send them again.

`SUMMARY_PROMPT` is now neutral (done / left / errors) and allows tools, because an empty stop doesn't mean the work is finished; the model must still end with a text reply.

Decisions on the open questions: retry limit is 3 in a row, also bounded by `timeout`; the default stays 16384 and the README documents what happens at the limit.

Tests are in `src/run.test.ts` and cover every acceptance case, plus the count reset, partial text in the give-up comment, and dedup on a later run. `npm run check` passes.

=== 37
When a run works on a stored thread (`refs/pi/threads/<n>`), pi-action now writes the commands of [Read a thread](docs/threads.md#read-a-thread) for that ref and remote, after the final push of the run:

```
::group::How to read refs/pi/threads/42 with git
This conversation is stored in git on refs/pi/threads/42. To read it:
  git fetch origin 'refs/pi/threads/42:refs/pi/threads/42'
  git log --oneline refs/pi/threads/42            # one commit for each stored step
  git show refs/pi/threads/42:batch.json | jq .   # the records of the newest step
See https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/main/docs/threads.md#read-a-thread
::endgroup::
```

- **Where it goes.** The commands go in a collapsible log group, so they don't clutter the log, and the group title shows the ref. They also go in the job summary as a short section (a heading, one sentence, and the code block). The summary is the run's landing page, and `output` mode and `pr_number` runs post no comment that shows the ref. If the job summary cannot be written, pi-action logs a warning.
- **When.** Once per run, in `run()`'s `finally` after `closeThread()`, so it also happens when the run fails, times out, or ends on a question. Direct prompts without an issue or PR store nothing (`thread.ref` is undefined), so they print nothing.
- **Small change.** `Logger` gets `startGroup`/`endGroup`, which `index.ts` maps to `@actions/core`. The text is in `formatting.ts`, and `run.ts` gets one helper and a 3-line hook in `finally`. No other changes to `run.ts`, because of the #33 work.
- **Tests.** Exact text for the log and the summary. A test checks that the commands match `docs/threads.md`, and another that the group is written after the push (the remote tip already equals the local tip). It is also printed on timeout failure and on a question, it is not printed for a direct prompt, and a failing job summary gives a warning.
- **Docs.** README (the threads feature bullet), `docs/threads.md` (Read a thread), and `docs/how-it-works.md` (the Save step).

`npm run check` passes locally.
=== 41
Closes #38.

pi-action no longer installs `commit-msg` or `prepare-commit-msg` hooks in the target repository. Commit conventions are the repository's job: its own hooks, CI checks, and `AGENTS.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

## Changes

- **`feat: stop installing git hooks in the target repository`**
  - Removes the "Install pi-agent git hooks" step from `action.yml`, and deletes `scripts/install-agent-hooks.js` and `scripts/hooks.test.js`.
  - `scripts/prepare-commit-msg.js` stays. It is this repository's own prek hook, not the injected one, so its tests move to `scripts/prepare-commit-msg.test.js`. Its knip entries and the vitest `scripts/**/*.test.js` include stay for the same reason.
  - New tests:
    - `src/entrypoints.test.ts`: `action.yml` runs only `src/index.ts` and `src/push.ts`, and its `runs:` section never mentions hooks, `core.hooksPath` or `--git-path`.
    - `src/run.test.ts`: on a checkout with `core.hooksPath=.githooks`, a run where pi commits `release: v0.35.1` (the cv/pit#353 case) leaves `.git/hooks` as it was (only `*.sample`), creates no `.githooks/`, leaves the working tree clean, and keeps the commit message unchanged (no `Refs #…`).
- **`docs: say that pi follows the repository's own commit conventions`**: changes the README feature bullet and docs table, and `docs/how-it-works.md` (removes the hooks step and the "Git hooks for the agent" section, adds a "Commit conventions" section). In CONTRIBUTING it drops the links to the agent hooks and the file-table row. The current files had no README "How It Works" step 4 and no CONTRIBUTING bullet around line 167; these are the places that actually described the agent hooks.
- **`docs: add AGENTS.md that points agents to the commit conventions`**: a short root `AGENTS.md` that points to CONTRIBUTING's commit messages, `npm run check`, and the documentation style. `src/docs.test.ts` checks its links too.

`npm run check` (typecheck, lint, coverage, knip/jscpd) passes on this branch.

## ⚠️ Needs a maintainer: the commitlint CI job

The pi-action-agent App token can create PRs now, but it still can't push workflow files: `refusing to allow a GitHub App to create or update workflow .github/workflows/ci.yml without workflows permission`. You can give the App the **Workflows: write** permission, or apply the commit below yourself:

```bash
gh pr checkout feat/38-no-agent-hooks
# save the patch below as ci.patch
git am ci.patch && git push
```

It adds a `commitlint` job to `ci.yml` (pull requests only) that runs `npx --no -- commitlint --from $BASE_SHA --to $HEAD_SHA --verbose` with the existing `commitlint.config.js`. It also adds the matching row in CONTRIBUTING and the line in AGENTS.md, and removes `@commitlint/cli` from knip's `ignoreDependencies`, because knip sees it used now and `--treat-config-hints-as-errors` would fail otherwise. Checked locally with the patch applied:
- `npm run check` passes.
- This PR's commits (`origin/main..HEAD`) pass commitlint with exit 0, no problems and no warnings.
- The same range plus a `release: v0.35.1` commit fails (exit 1, `type-enum`).

<details><summary>ci.patch</summary>

```diff
From 0a22c011c5266249cb41752dadd21e61f518fbf2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "pi-action-agent[bot]"
 <355532786+pi-action-agent[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 00:00:35 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] ci: check the commits of each pull request with commitlint
",
  "stderr": "",
  "code": 0,
  "truncated": false
}
